audit.why: 51.46% over 1195 games; EVEN / 6-10 fits a lane Fiora owns to level 3 and loses from the first AP item onward.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 1 was 'Skill' and both item rows were given to Fiora, against the packet chart and the page's own whys[0], whys[5] and whys[6].
audit.why: whys[0] calls Fiora 'the premier level-1 duelist' here; whys[5] says his first AP item is 'tipping the lane his way'; whys[6] and late say he out-scales hard.
audit.corrected: Level 1 -> Fiora; First item and 2+ items -> Sylas, with phases[5].why and phases[6].why rewritten to carry the reason.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page repeatedly credits Chain Lash (Q) with a shield. Riot's description contains no shield.
audit.why: Riot text: 'Sylas lashes his chains out, intersecting at his targeted location dealing damage to and slowing enemies. After a delay, magical energy explodes from the intersection point dealing damage.' The real mechanic to play around is the delayed detonation at the intersection point — step off it and half his poke never lands. Kingslayer (W) heals only against champions and is on 12/10.5/9/7.5/6s, which is the sustain clock that matters. Abscond (E) is 13/12/11/10/9s and its recast pulls Sylas to the target he hits.
audit.corrected: Replace 'Q shield' with Chain Lash's delayed blast at the intersection, and state Kingslayer's cooldown as the sustain clock.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page asserts Abduct (E2) is a stun and that Riposte parries it into a stun. Riot's text does not describe any stun on that ability.
audit.why: Riot text for E: 'Sylas dashes to a location. Sylas can recast the ability to throw his chains out, pulling himself to an enemy he hits.' The derived flags on that ability list projectile and dash only — no hardCC. Riposte returns a stun only if it blocks an immobilizing effect, so the whole 'parry E2 for the stun' plan rests on a property the kit file does not confirm. It is left in place rather than removed, because 'the file is silent' is not the same as 'it does not stun'.

edits.before: Ravenous Hydra is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Abscond / Abduct's cooldown.
edits.after: His first AP item lets Kingslayer out-heal loose Vital pokes — only all-ins pay from here, never chip.

edits.after: Two items on, Sylas takes over: he heals through your Vitals instead of tanking them, and he holds your own ult. End it early.

edits.before: Even — his W lifesteal and Q shield come online and match your chip unless you parry the E2 pull and commit a full all-in.
edits.after: Even — Kingslayer heals him every 9s and Chain Lash's delayed blast matches your chip unless you parry the E2 and all-in.

notes: Chain Lash does not shield — Riot's text gives it a slow plus a delayed detonation at the intersection point, and that is what the rewritten lines now say. The 'Abduct stuns' claim underpinning most of the Riposte advice on this page is NOT confirmed by the kit file (no hardCC flag, no stun in Riot's text); it was left untouched rather than guessed either way, and is raised in questionsForUser.
